svg.title: Cloud and hybrid networking: the same ideas with new names
svg.desc: Every cloud building block maps to something you already built in Packet Tracer, now defined as software and managed by Terraform
svg.text: Cloud and hybrid networking: the same ideas with new names
Every cloud building block maps to something you already built in Packet Tracer, now defined as software and managed by Terraform
allow tcp:443 from internet to tag 'web'
subnets route to each other automatically
CLASSIC TERM → CLOUD TERM → TERRAFORM RESOURCE
Nothing new at the packet level: still IP, subnets, routes, firewalls, NAT and DNS — just declared in code.
Terraform describes the desired network; the cloud provider builds and operates the 'switches and routers' for you.
